name.fr: bataille de la baie de Mobile

sources.label: NHHC · Farragut’s report, Mobile Bay, 5 August 1864

note: Equipment review: the anonymous event illustration uses the wooden screw-sloop component represented by Hartford. Farragut’s report separately documents monitors, wooden steamships, Confederate gunboats, Tennessee and shore forts; their proportions and opposing camps are not reconstructed by this single equipment family.
